label: Grok
depicts: Circular swirl ring with one diagonal slash line cutting across the center
use_when: Use when the interface wants a curved circular mark cut by a diagonal slash line.
avoid_when: Do not use for the square grok mark when the outer border should stay box shaped.

label: Group
depicts: Two person busts with one large head left and one smaller head right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a two person group with one main bust and one secondary bust.
avoid_when: Do not use for the three person group when a third head should appear above the center.

label: Group
depicts: Three person busts with one centered head above two smaller side heads
use_when: Use when the interface wants a three person group with one centered main figure and two side figures.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two person group when only one side companion should appear.

label: Hair
depicts: Rounded hair silhouette with one centered face opening and two lower locks
use_when: Use when the interface wants a broad hairstyle framing a centered face opening.
avoid_when: Do not use for the single hair lock icon when the shape should not frame a full face opening.

label: Hair
depicts: Single curved hair lock with one inner loop centered inside the outline
use_when: Use when the interface wants a single hair strand or lock instead of a full hairstyle silhouette.
avoid_when: Do not use for the full hair silhouette when the icon should frame a face opening.
